About — The person behind the site

HI, I’MBHAVISHYA.

I build AI products, make videos about the tools I use, and write down what I learn along the way. The line on the home page is the honest summary: I am figuring things out, and doing it in public.

What I do

Four things, most weeks.

Building
Small AI products that each fix one annoying thing: Ring Ping, Rank Kiwi and LinkedInRank.
Writing
AI This Week, a newsletter on LinkedIn that helps freshers find their way in an AI-driven job market, and the articles on this site.
Making videos
Shorts about the AI tools I actually use, and an animated micro-drama that has my own products written into the plot.
Teaching
AI For Everyone, my Millennium Fellowship project: content, school visits and college sessions on using AI critically and responsibly.

How I work

Build the thing, show the bill, say what went wrong.

Most of what I publish starts as an experiment I wanted to run anyway. Can three AI models make the same video, and what does each one cost? Can a free tool clone my voice as well as a paid one? Can AI edit a whole reel for the price of a snack? I run it, write down the real numbers and share it, including the parts that did not work.

I care more about whether people understand AI than whether they are impressed by it. Anyone can get an answer from a model in seconds. Knowing when to question that answer is the skill, and it is the one I try to teach, in videos, in classrooms and here.
